entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: ¶Proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: to receive the instruction of wisdom, righteousness and judgment, and equity;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: to give prudence to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: He that is wise will hear, and will increase learning; and the intelligent will gain wise counsels:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: to understand a proverb and an allegory, the words of the wise and their enigmas.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: ¶The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge: fools despise wisdom and instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the teaching of thy mother;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: for they shall be a garland of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: ¶My son, if sinners entice thee, consent not.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, and whole, as those that go down into the pit;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: we shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: cast in thy lot among us; we will all have one purse:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: --my son, walk not in the way with them, keep back thy foot from their path;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: for their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed blood.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: For in vain the net is spread in the sight of anything which hath wings.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: And these lay wait for their own blood; they lurk secretly for their own lives.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: So are the paths of every one that is greedy of gain: it taketh away the life of its possessors.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: ¶Wisdom crieth without; she raiseth her voice in the broadways;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: she calleth in the chief [place] of concourse, in the entry of the gates; in the city she uttereth her words:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: How long, simple ones, will ye love simpleness, and scorners take pleasure in their scorning, and the foolish hate knowledge?

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour forth my spirit unto you, I will make known to you my words.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one regarded;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: and ye have rejected all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: I also will laugh in your calamity, I will mock when your fear cometh;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: when your fear cometh as sudden destruction, and your calamity cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come upon you:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: --then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; they will seek me early, and shall not find me.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: Because they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of Jehovah;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: they would none of my counsel, they despised all my reproof:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their way, and be filled with their own devices.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of the foolish shall cause them to perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be at rest from fear of evil.
